source_problem: An Instant consumer first validated UTC through an OffsetDateTime-based String boundary, then parsed the original returned String again as Instant. These are different parser languages and exception layers.
selected_owner_change: For only a bounded canonical ASCII UTC shape and a successful Instant parse, return that Instant. All negative shape cases, rejected instants and special forms still execute the exact original two-stage expression. Do not normalize a String differently or broaden the fast path to every form accepted by only one parser.

lesson: Freeze the real outer consumer expression and first-failure layers. A generic language mismatch is not a counterexample to a restricted successful subset, and complete valid JSON is not a qualified implementation.
